description: The AI monitors contact quality, process adherence, and sentiment across every brand, and surfaces the compliance risk — the skipped auto-renewal disclosure — as a flagged signal six days before it would reach an audit.

The AI ties the disclosure-skip spike to the exact macro change that caused it, pinpoints the shift where it concentrates, and quantifies the regulatory exposure — the correlation the raw quality score cannot show.
Revert the macro, generate the remediation list of affected contacts split by resolution path, and draft the compliance incident summary — executed from the conversation, pending your approval.

The AI correlates repeat-contact transcripts with IT incident logs to find the real root cause — a billing-sync delay, not agent error — and connects the quality miss to the one-star reviews it is spilling into.
